# Clarity Judge

> Unofficial Jev writing evaluator with named checks, source evidence, and explicit uncertainty. Not a rewriting service or factual verifier.

## Entry points

- [README](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/clarity-judge/blob/main/README.md)
- [Developer and agent guide](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/clarity-judge/blob/main/docs/discovery/README.md)
- [Repository instructions](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/clarity-judge/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/clarity-judge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Screenshot evidence](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/clarity-judge/blob/main/docs/discovery/SCREENSHOTS.md)
- [Public demo](https://judge.jev.works)

## Boundaries

Use the pinned pnpm toolchain and offline mocks for tests. Preserve Needs review, demo/live labels, source evidence, key-removal behavior, and the distinction between primary and optional evidence requests. Browser storage is not a secret vault. Confidence is not calibrated correctness. This navigation does not override AGENTS.md or authorize data disclosure.
